mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fms_cost_breakdown (breakdown_id, tenant_id, cost_event_id, cost_type, cost_category, amount, currency, exchange_rate, amount_in_base_currency, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{breakdownId}, #{tenantId}, #{costEventId}, #{costType}, #{costCategory}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{exchangeRate}, #{amountInBaseCurrency}, #{remark}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO fms_journal_entry (entry_id, tenant_id, account_code, account_name, type, amount, currency, reference_type, reference_id, remark, entry_date, created_at) VALUES (#{entryId}, #{tenantId}, #{accountCode}, #{accountName}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{referenceType}, #{referenceId}, #{remark}, #{entryDate}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO fms_tax_rule (rule_id, tenant_id, country_code, tax_type, tax_rate, tax_category, enabled, effective_from, effective_to, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{tenantId}, #{countryCode}, #{taxType}, #{taxRate}, #{taxCategory}, #{enabled}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT rule_id, tenant_id, country_code, tax_type, tax_rate, tax_category, enabled, effective_from, effective_to, created_at, updated_at FROM fms_tax_rule WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rule_id = #{ruleId}

SELECT rule_id, tenant_id, country_code, tax_type, tax_rate, tax_category, enabled, effective_from, effective_to, created_at, updated_at FROM fms_tax_rule WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND country_code = #{countryCode} AND tax_type = #{taxType} AND enabled = true AND effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE fms_cost_aggregation_rule SET rule_name = #{ruleName}, cost_source = #{costSource}, cost_category = #{costCategory}, allocation_method = #{allocationMethod}, allocation_basis = #{allocationBasis}, target_dimension = #{targetDimension}, enabled = #{enabled}, priority = #{priority}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rule_id = #{ruleId}
mapper.select: SELECT rule_id, tenant_id, rule_name, cost_source, cost_category, allocation_method, allocation_basis, target_dimension, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at FROM fms_cost_aggregation_rule WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (#{costSource} IS NULL OR cost_source = #{costSource}) ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT result_id, tenant_id, rule_id, cost_event_id, target_dimension, target_id, allocated_amount, currency, exchange_rate, amount_in_base_currency, dimensions_json, allocated_at FROM fms_cost_allocation_result WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dimensions_json LIKE CONCAT('%"sellerSku":"', #{sellerSku}, '"%') ORDER BY allocated_at DESC, result_id DESC
